name: proven-warning

finding.title: `rows` runs one `Order` query per user
finding.description: The PR replaces the grouped query with `Order.where(user_id: user.id).sum(:amount_cents)` inside `users.map`. A summary of N users now runs N queries where it ran one. The rows are the same, but the report gets slower with every user.
finding.suggestedFix: Keep the grouped query and read each total from its result.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/reports/order_summary.rb b/app/reports/order_summary.rb
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/reports/order_summary.rb
+++ b/app/reports/order_summary.rb
@@ -6,6 +6,8 @@
 class OrderSummary
   def rows(users)
-    totals = Order.where(user_id: users.map(&:id)).group(:user_id).sum(:amount_cents)
-    users.map { |user| [user.email, totals.fetch(user.id, 0)] }
+    users.map do |user|
+      total = Order.where(user_id: user.id).sum(:amount_cents)
+      [user.email, total]
+    end
   end
 end
